status: reviewed; matched-estimator direction proposed, implementation unrun
accepted: Opus withdraws its claimed unique exact-4/+4match and impossible-equality assertion. Conditional interpolation identities now stated accurately.

A simulated/cohort model-panel auxiliary regression is a defensible direction for comparing the same empirical statistic; no new behavioral state is inherently required. It needs measurement code and a declared observation rule.
Frozen diagnostic targets and observer remain unchanged. No single final event window is yet justified merely by period length.
lead_qualifications: Endogenous never-parent selection can invalidate parallel trends; its failure is not proved merely by naming selection. Treat model regression as an auxiliary descriptive statistic unless causal assumptions are justified.
The gap between a simulated regression and forced-branch contrast is a discrepancy, not a bound on selection/anticipation components; components can cancel.
Uniform,zero andmidpoint birth dates are sensitivity conventions, not rigorous bounds. Arbitrary timing laws/effect dependence may lie outside their envelope.

Marginal cohort/event support does not reconstruct individual interview histories or missingness and therefore cannot alone reproduce the fixed-effects estimator design. A joint observation-pattern design is required.

Dropping education only in the model is not the identical empirical specification. Either explicitly justify different conditioning or construct a correspondingly reduced empirical estimator as a new candidate, preserving the current source.
Material prebirth change does not automatically justify selecting an earlier window or establish causal anticipation. Choose the auxiliary statistic and interpretation before examining model fit.
new_empirical_evidence: Independent saved-covariance check verifies nine contrasts, maxgap4.44e-16. On23commoncohorts/fixed-4weights: -4/+4=1.257092,SE.126568; -4/-2=.398415,SE.101046; residual-2/+4=.858678,SE.100923. Eight-year change includes substantial prebirth movement. These do not establish exact model mapping.
next_decision: Propose matched measurement principle, choose and test a transparent model observation protocol; do not introduce an automatic8-year target or halve an existing model moment. No further broad Opus review is needed.
